pages.title: Race Won
pages.text: Race Won plays in Skitchin' when you finish in the top five and move on to the next city. Then the game adds up your bonuses for Race, Thrash, Trick, Skitchin', Police and Warp.

pages.title: The billboard warp
pages.text: One of the tips in Skitchin' says, "I once jumped into a billboard, and somehow warped to another city. I can't remember where that billboard was though." The warp even has its own sound effect.

pages.title: Jeff van Dyck after Skitchin'
pages.text: Composer Jeff van Dyck went on to Need for Speed, working with guitarist Saki Kaskas. He won a BAFTA in 2001 for Shogun: Total War and later led the audio on Alien: Isolation, which also won a BAFTA.
